_encoding_note: Each row's capabilities map gives, per capability, the set of packet-16 helm-levels (0-3) at which that capability is PROVEN supported today, plus an evidence_ref. Level 3 (MC Master Console, packet-16: 'long-term target') is NOT built for ANY helm yet — no row's supported_levels includes 3. That is a Phase-2+ deliverable (RATIFIED-PLAN Phase 2: per-helm trusted bindings), not a Phase-0 fabrication. This is the Phase-0 SEED granularity; Phase-1 F3 refines with the prompt-shape dimension (RATIFIED-PLAN Phase 1).

agy-antigravity.note: CONTRACTED (RATIFIED-PLAN panel-3lab is the binding 1.0 profile; agy is IN-SCOPE Phase-1 work). status:down / proven:false STANDS (α-ratified 2026-07-18). CORRECTION 2026-07-18 (SP-20260718-003, QA-HG-001): the agy CLI is now PRESENT and its TRANSPORT/plumbing WORKS (agy invocation syntax exists in providers.js/safe-spawn; spawn returns exit 0 + output; the earlier 'zero records ever' is stale — records DO exist). The `fallback:false` agy ledger records are unauthenticated-default output, NOT a genuine authenticated serve — the prior 'agy PROVEN LIVE / §7 CONCLUDES' claim was a cert-attest substring-echo FALSE-GREEN, retracted (ADR-0023 CORRECTION; QA-HG-001 fixed evaluateAttestation to require positive served-model proof). A down REQUIRED lane resolves BLOCKED, never a silent pass (see durable_rule below).

durable_rule: A lane resolved DOWN is reflected in EVERY artifact that assumed it UP. conformance-matrix.js reads the 'status' field directly (not a cached/echoed liveness claim) so a false-green agy seed cannot propagate into the Phase-1 G1.5 panel lane contract — a config-intent echo is NOT liveness (the exact trap that fooled the 2026-07-16 attestation).
write_durable_state_note: S-3 disambiguation (gauntlet round 1 fix): a row's 'write-durable-state' capability describes an UNTRUSTED-PROPOSAL capability -- a provider writing to an isolated worktree it does not control the integration of, or proposing a change via the trusted dispatch bridge (scripts/dispatch-claude.js / scripts/dispatch-agent.js). It does NOT mean, and must never be read as, a grant of CORE-2's protected-mutation or integration-to-main powers (top-level-runtime-contract.md §1/§4) -- those two powers stay SOLELY with the provider-independent trusted layer regardless of any row's supported_levels here. See each row's write-durable-state.evidence_ref for the per-provider restatement.
durable_state_mutation_capabilities_note: N-3 [HIGH, gauntlet round 1 fix scoped write-durable-state but MISSED its sibling]: the S-3 disambiguation above applies to EVERY capability in this matrix that mutates durable company state, not only 'write-durable-state'. 'update-tracker' is the other one today -- top-level-runtime-contract.md §1 names trackers explicitly among the four CORE-2 protected-mutation targets ('trackers, ledgers, registries'), so a row's update-tracker capability is under the exact same S-3 disambiguation: PROPOSAL via an isolated worktree or the trusted dispatch bridge, never direct protected mutation of the integrated/main TRACKER.md. See each row's update-tracker.evidence_ref for the per-provider restatement (gauntlet round 2 fix). Any FUTURE capability added to this matrix that mutates durable company state must receive the same per-capability evidence_ref treatment -- do not leave a sibling capability unscoped again.
